configuration.input_patterns: Cycle 64 prebuilt arrays. Within that fixture: index%13==0 gives a NULL parent; otherwise index%7==0 gives an empty parent; all other parents have three elements with the middle element NULL. Scalar edge values repeat by seven slots. The function mutates the first element and clears the List after synchronous collection.

earlier_measurements.reason: Initial 2.2 candidate overlapped two other Java processes. A one-time quieter 2.2 follow-up retained all trials. Subsequent review replaced the no-children scalar proxy with the explicit atomic type category, excluding zero-field ROW; the final exact-source matrix above measures that planner-only refinement. The callback and Arrow runtime did not change. No optimization prototype was attempted.
An AtomicDataType can wrap a zero-field logical ROW. The final guard uses the predefined logical family instead; the callback, Arrow implementation and timed fixture bodies did not change.

bounded_profiling.decision: Stop after one sixteen-second profile. 48 table-operator stacks point to the existing callback and owned Arrow writes (14 leaves in IntWriter null checks); no isolated concrete-result bridge hotspot or easy safe class-specific improvement. No prototype or fixture optimization.
bounded_profiling.post_profile_changes: Planner scalar classification was tightened from a no-children proxy to the predefined logical-type family, with empty-ROW controls for normal and AtomicDataType representations. Callback/Arrow implementations and timed fixture bodies are unchanged; one profile, no optimization prototype.
